name: Finland
summary: Nordic boreal nation with the highest proportion of forest cover in Europe. Maintains exceptionally clean ambient air quality alongside low-carbon electricity anchored by nuclear and biomass.

pm25.name: Annual Mean PM2.5 Exposure
pm25.source_dataset: State of Global Air (SOGA) 2024 / Global Burden of Disease
pm25.context: 1.08x the WHO 2021 annual guideline (5 µg/m³); cleanest ambient particulate air quality measured in Europe.

temp_anomaly.name: Surface Temperature Anomaly
temp_anomaly.context: Relative to 1951-1980 baseline; subpolar warming impacts winter snowpack duration and lake ice cover.

temp_trend.name: 30-Year Warming Trend Rate
temp_trend.context: High-latitude warming rate of +0.46 °C per decade over trailing 30-year window (1994-2023).

co2_total.name: Total Territorial Fossil CO2
co2_total.context: 0.09% share of global fossil emissions; legally binding net-zero target by 2035.

co2_per_capita.name: Per Capita Fossil CO2
co2_per_capita.context: Space heating demands in subarctic winters balanced by forest industry biogenic co-generation.

forest_share.name: Forest Cover Fraction
forest_share.source_dataset: Global Forest Resources Assessment via World Bank (AG.LND.FRST.ZS)
forest_share.context: Most forested nation in Europe; boreal pine and spruce cover ~224,000 km².

renewables_share.name: Renewable Share of Electricity
renewables_share.context: Hydro (14.2%), onshore wind (18.6%), and forestry bioenergy (20.8%) complement 41.5% nuclear generation.

population.name: Total Population & Density
population.context: Sparse arithmetic population density of 18 people/km²; urban population fraction is 85.5%.
